name: Counterguard
summary: Playing a Skill primes your next Attack for +4 damage. Attacking consumes the counter.

name: Arcane Charges
summary: Each Skill grants one charge, up to three. Your next Attack gains +2 damage per charge and consumes them.

name: Hunter Rhythm
summary: Every third Attack in a turn draws one card and applies one Vulnerable to its target. Area attacks mark all enemies; random-hit attacks mark a random enemy.
